nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable holding the constant token price set at deployment.
Constructor taking _price and writing it into the tokenPrice state variable; runs once at deployment.
Constructor parameter providing the initial constant price value.
External view function returning the stored tokenPrice value; read-only oracle accessor.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _price is assigned to the tokenPrice state variable (tokenPrice = _price).
Constructor writes the initial price into the tokenPrice state variable.
getPrice reads the tokenPrice state variable and returns it to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter _price is only used to initialize the state variable within the constructor and has no independent semantic identity; it is merged into the constructor function node.
